messages:
maria: quick idea: expose a tiny checkpoint token every N items so clients can resume if iterator fails. token should be opaque. opinions?

tyler: +1. add `checkpoint_interval` call option default 0 (disabled) or 100.

jon: how do we guarantee token validity across backends? must be best-effort; document as opaque and non-guaranteed.

ruta: on retries: transport should attach `attempts` metadata to events. console team wants per-page attempt histograms.

maria: agreed. also `preserve_order` true by default. if user sets false we can return items asap from concurrent page fetches. document reordering risk.

tyler: for non-idempotent endpoints we should disable transparent retries unless `idempotency_key` provided. make that explicit.

jon: tests: add resume test using checkpoint, inject failure after checkpoint, assert resume continues.

sdk-ci-bot: canary branch for checkpoint API CI passed: https://ci.internal/redwood/1299
